record.name: Zambia
record.summary: No qualifying institute identified. The national AI strategy (February 2025) proposes a National AI Council as an expert advisory group to the Ministry of Technology and Science, plus regulatory and data sandboxes; neither is an evaluation institute.

partial.scope: Negative-status confidence, preserved query provenance, national/official-language search coverage and source-independence audit; this is not a full recheck of all record fields.

Reassessed negative confidence under the revised rule using saved research. Recorded English and national or official-language queries and retrieved primary governance evidence support medium confidence. No new search or full recheck.
Attempted preservation of cited source copies and checked saved-copy hashes; failures remain in source access notes. This source-evidence work is not a full factual recheck of the record.

check.language_note: English is an official language or an official language of national administration; it is a practical national search language for this check. Other national or official languages were not exhaustively searched. Some submitted strings contain site. rather than site:; these literal strings are preserved and are not treated as domain-restricted searches. Search source_ids identify registered source URLs matched in the retrieved result set, which may include irrelevant hits. An empty list means no registered source URL was matched, not that the web response was empty. The earlier audit used independent_source_ids for substantive corroboration; governance_source_ids, where present, identifies the selected primary governance evidence. Preserved result batches, using 1-based positions in check.searches: ZM-search = searches 1, 2 (en, en). Each multi-query batch has only a combined returned result set; its source_ids cannot be attributed to individual queries. Historical query dates are recorded as 17 October 2026 in the phase6 search-boundary ledger.
check.independence_note: Historical audit under the superseded two-independent-sources rule: Two substantively independent evidence origins were not established. Multiple pages from one owner, mirrors, reports of the same underlying announcement and general regional coverage are not counted as independent corroboration.
check.governance_note: The retrieved national AI strategy defines implementation and governance structures, including ministry coordination and advisory roles, without an identified qualifying evaluator.

related_bodies.name: National AI Council (proposed)
related_bodies.role: It would advise the Ministry of Technology and Science as an expert group. It is not an evaluation body.

related_bodies.name: Ministry of Technology and Science
related_bodies.role: It owns the national AI strategy.

record.notes:
The strategy text was read directly. It describes an advisory council giving high-level implementation advice, and national standards and certification processes. Establishment of the council was not verified.

The ministry records a UNESCO AI readiness workshop on 22–23 June 2026. The ministry also describes a review of progress under the National AI Strategy. English-language searches for a government-designated AI safety institute with a remit to evaluate advanced models included a separate search of gov.zm.

next_check.reason: Check whether the National AI Council or sandboxes are established.
